headline: Adeleke presents ₦927bn 2027 budget to assembly
summary: Governor Ademola Adeleke presented a ₦927.37bn Osun 2027 budget to the state assembly. Sixty per cent is allocated to capital projects, with a focus on infrastructure and jobs.
why: State budgets set public spending on infrastructure and services in Nigeria's sub-national economies, which shapes local construction demand and government finances.
